textStyles.name: Heading 1
textStyles.description: Used for the main screen title, should be used only once per screen. It pairs with base body.

textStyles.name: Heading 2
textStyles.description: Used for main section titles within a screen. Provides hierarchy below Heading 1 and should be used sparingly. Pairs with body base.

textStyles.name: Heading 3
textStyles.description: Used for subsection titles or important content blocks. Helps break down information within a section. Pairs with body sm or body base.

textStyles.name: Heading 4
textStyles.description: Used for subsection titles or important content blocks. Helps break down information within a section. Pairs with body sm or body base.

textStyles.name: Body base
textStyles.description: Default paragraph style for most content. Optimized for readability at medium sizes. Used across long-form text, descriptions, and details.

textStyles.name: Body base medium
textStyles.description: Same as body base, but with medium font weight. Provides subtle emphasis for key points, labels, or short content blocks.

textStyles.name: Body sm
textStyles.description: Used for secondary or supporting text. Ideal for captions, metadata, and content with lower emphasis.

textStyles.name: Body sm medium
textStyles.description: Same as body small, but with medium font weight. Provides stronger emphasis for small text, such as inline labels or status indicators.

textStyles.name: Body xs
textStyles.description: Used for fine print, footnotes, and dense UI elements where space is limited. Should not be overused.

textStyles.name: Body xs medium
textStyles.description: Same as body xs, but with medium font weight. Adds clarity and hierarchy in tight spaces like tables or input helpers.

textStyles.name: Link base
textStyles.description: Default link style for inline navigation or actions. Used in body content, menus, or lists.

textStyles.name: Link sm
textStyles.description: Used for inline links in smaller text contexts such as captions, footnotes, or secondary actions.

textStyles.name: Link sm hover
textStyles.description: Used for inline links in smaller text contexts such as captions, footnotes, or secondary actions.

textStyles.name: Text field base
textStyles.description: Used for input text in standard fields. Optimized for readability at medium size with comfortable line height. Balances clarity with density for forms and interactive components.

textStyles.name: Text field sm
textStyles.description: Used for input text in compact fields. Ideal for dense layouts or secondary forms where space is limited. Maintains legibility at smaller sizes.

textStyles.name: Button base
textStyles.description: Primary button text style. Optimized for legibility and balance within medium/large buttons.

textStyles.name: Button sm
textStyles.description: Button text style for compact buttons. Used where space is limited while keeping readability.
